Between recent automated takedowns and specific conflict-of-interest disputes, several distinct trends in suspensions have emerged.1. The Automated Spam and AI-Content Purges (2026)With Zenodo dealing with over 240,000 blocked accounts and 1.1 million removed records, the most widespread bans are automated.The Crimson Hexagonal Case: One prominent incident (tracked under #2606 on GitHub) involved an independent researcher having their account terminated and approximately 870 records erased.Reasoning: Zenodo cited the submission of "substantially AI-generated content without a verifiable research basis".False Positives: Users have consistently reported their legitimate research getting falsely flagged by automated spam bots, requiring them to go through manual review queues to restore access.2.
